towns.name: Westwatch
towns.summary: Westwatch is the Viamontian knights' western lookout on the south-west shore of Lotila Island, westernmost of the frigid Halaetan Isles (72.8N 73.4W), named in the town-network sign for the isle of the murdered Countess Marena du Lotila. It is a tiny outpost on a low green meadow (z 2-6) just above a sandy beach and the shallow sea: a four-storey stone watch tower with a golden tapered roof (the same lighthouse model as Eastwatch), a two-storey Viamontian hall with red lion banners housing the archmage, healer and shopkeeper, and a small mirror shrine, with five golden lamps burning blue flames, a Life Stone, the Town Network portal and the destroyed portal to Sanamar. Banderlings, drudges and Ruschk roam the rugged hills behind; the Cataracts of Sabella and the Lotila Lighthouse lie far to the north.
